name: Hammertoe's Amulet
summary: Hammertoe’s Amulet is a dwarf’s keepsake from his search into Uldaman’s past. In the Badlands, it carries his work onward to those who knew him.

sections.title: A Dwarf’s Charge
sections.body: Wounded in the Badlands, Hammertoe asks you to carry his amulet to Prospector Ryedol. Hammertoe had been searching for the origins of his people and trying to stop the Shadowforge clan from finding the scrolls. Ryedol knows of that work, and Hammertoe trusts him to decide what must be done.

sections.title: In Ironforge
sections.body: After hearing what happened to Hammertoe, Ryedol sends you to Historian Karnik in Ironforge. Karnik and Hammertoe had worked together to find lost artifacts in Uldaman. The amulet carries their work into Karnik’s hands, and he sees that it bears on more than grief for his companion.

faq.answer: Hammertoe was a dwarf searching for the origins of his people in Uldaman. He also worked to keep the Shadowforge clan from finding the scrolls.

faq.q: Why does Hammertoe give me his amulet?
aliases: what do i do with amulet
faq.answer: Hammertoe asks you to take the amulet to Prospector Ryedol in the Badlands. Ryedol knows about Hammertoe’s search and can decide what to do next.
Prospector Ryedol is the dwarf Hammertoe trusts with his amulet and his work in Uldaman.
The amulet belonged to Hammertoe and represents his work searching Uldaman for the origins of his people. Ryedol and Historian Karnik know that work.
Historian Karnik is in Ironforge and worked with Hammertoe to find lost artifacts in Uldaman. Ryedol directs you to him with the amulet.

faq.q: What was Hammertoe trying to stop?
faq.answer: Hammertoe sought to stop the Shadowforge clan from finding the scrolls in Uldaman.

angles.text: As a dwarf, Hammertoe’s search for the origins of his people touches your own heritage. His amulet carries that work to the scholars who knew him.
